meta.name: anxiety-tracker-trigger-map-coping-planner
meta.description: Track anxiety episodes, triggers, thoughts, and coping responses with therapy-ready logs, weekly trend reviews, and safety-first escalation cues.

copy.tagline: 记录焦虑发作与触发因素，生成治疗就绪日志
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常焦虑并想系统记录触发因素和应对方式
copy.tagline_en: Track anxiety episodes and triggers, generate therapy-ready logs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often feel anxious and want to systematically track triggers and coping responses

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会帮你记录焦虑发作的时间、情境、触发因素、身体症状、焦虑程度和应对行为，生成适合治疗使用的日志；还能每周总结趋势，并在发现安全风险时立即提醒。
howto.when: 当你想记录焦虑事件、分析触发模式、制定应对计划或查看趋势回顾时，Claude会主动进入该技能。

say.text: 帮我记录刚才的焦虑发作。
say.note: Claude会引导你填写事件日志模板。

say.text: 分析我最近的焦虑触发模式。
say.note: Claude会调取日志并梳理常见触发因素。

howto.what_en: This skill helps you log anxiety episodes with time, context, triggers, body symptoms, intensity, and coping responses, producing therapy-ready logs. It also offers weekly trend reviews and safety escalation cues when risk signals appear.
howto.when_en: Activate when you want to track anxiety symptoms, panic episodes, worry spirals, avoidance patterns, or coping outcomes.

say_en.text: Log a recent anxiety episode for me.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the event log template.
Claude reviews logs and identifies common triggers.
